_meta.purpose: Grounding regression for Resolve's next steps. Each ticket exists on abhrademo4 and carries another agent's next-best-action in x_ustgl_backlog_be_u_next_best_action, which was compared by hand on 2026-09-30. Run with `npm run eval -- --resolve` against a running mockup (MOCKUP_URL, default http://localhost:3100).

checks.cited_refs_exist: every INC/KB/SOP number in a step's text or source is in the evidence the generator was given (look-alikes, articles, same-title tickets, the ticket itself)
checks.no_other_system_article: no cited article names a system the ticket does not
checks.no_hollow_precedent: no cited look-alike has boilerplate close notes
checks.escalation_when_escalated: when the only look-alikes were escalated, at least one step proposes escalation and none claims a prior fix
checks.no_evidence_stated: when no same-system article and no resolved look-alike exist, one step says so plainly
checks.caller_not_merged: no step names a look-alike's caller as this ticket's caller
checks.no_self_reference: no step reads NowOps's own earlier work notes as findings
